name: adjudant
description: Operate an Obsidian vault from your code project. One command, /adjudant, with five verbs: connect onboards a project and asks where it lives; status reports where you are, what is wrong, and what is stale; clean removes what the vault does not need; dream reads the prose and reports what only judgement finds; board runs a self-hosted kanban. Schema-locked vault writes, cost-gated heavy verbs, and ambient hooks that keep session notes, handoffs, and the board current. Stdlib-only Python helpers, no build step.
